hypothesis: The best reported T1 candidate is the 8x32 output tile at K-depth 16 (19.5267 ms). Increasing only its row tile to 16 while retaining 32 coalesced columns and K-depth 16 tests whether greater B-tile reuse and fewer CTAs outweigh twice as many threads per CTA and greater A staging. The 16x32, K-depth-32 candidate measured 22.8994 ms, so this is a distinct tile-shape experiment, not an assumed speedup.
